title: Localized tensor comparison inverse-shift conjugacy square
statement: Let R,A,B,C be commutative rings in one universe, A and B R-algebras, C an algebra over E=A tensor_R B, and fix derived categories of R-, A- and B-modules. Let F be termwise extension from A to C. Fix A-complexes U,Q, a C-complex N and a map t:F(Q) to N. Given a base-derived tensor cohomology model mU of U tensor Q, integers n and i, there exist a model mV of U[-n] tensor Q, a C-linear source isomorphism eS: C tensor_E mV.cohomology(i+n) to C tensor_E mU.cohomology(i), and a target isomorphism eT: H^(i+n)(F(U[-n]) tensor_C N) to H^i(F(U) tensor_C N), such that the degree-i localized comparison followed by H^i(mu_F(U,Q)^(-1) then F(U) tensor t) equals eS^(-1), followed by the corresponding degree-(i+n) comparison for U[-n], followed by eT. No K-flatness or invertibility hypothesis is imposed. Models and comparisons are those of [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]; the coefficient map and tensor conventions are those of [def-pc-localized-tensor-comparison-property].

proof.text: Use the canonical first-variable tensor shift e:U[-n] tensor Q to (U tensor Q)[-n]. Apply model transport to K=U tensor Q and L=U[-n] tensor Q to obtain mV, eS and the localization comparison equation with the prescribed target homology shift eH.

Construct the scalar-extension tensor shift eT on the target F(U) tensor N. Use the ordinary tensor comparison square for t. Apply the degree-(i+n) homology functor and Mathlib cohomology-shift naturality to obtain the ordinary comparison homology square.

Compose the model transport equation with the ordinary comparison homology square and reassociate. The resulting equation has witnesses mV, eS and the homology of the canonical target tensor shift followed by degree reindexing.

theorem exists_localizedTensorComparison_shift_square
    (U : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (n : ℤ)
    (mU : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (U ⊗ Q) C) (i : ℤ) :
    let F := (extendScalars.{u, u, u}
      ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)
    ∃ (mV : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B ((U⟦-n⟧) ⊗ Q) C)
      (eS : (extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C)).obj (mV.cohomology (i + n)) ≅
        (extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C)).obj (mU.cohomology i))
      (eT : (F.obj (U⟦-n⟧) ⊗ N).homology (i + n) ≅ (F.obj U ⊗ N).homology i),
    mU.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso F U Q).inv ≫ (F.obj U ◁ t)) i =
    eS.inv ≫ (mV.localizedComparison (i + n) ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso F (U⟦-n⟧) Q).inv ≫ (F.obj (U⟦-n⟧) ◁ t)) (i + n)) ≫
        eT.hom
